# SentinelX

SentinelX is an AI-powered blockchain security platform that analyzes Ethereum smart contracts and token addresses for potential rug-pull risks, honeypot patterns, and dangerous contract behaviors.

## What SentinelX Does

- Analyzes Ethereum smart contracts by address or raw Solidity source code
- Uses XGBoost machine learning trained on ~2,474 labeled contracts (2,391 rug pulls, 83 legitimate)
- Extracts 53 smart-contract features for risk evaluation
- Provides SHAP-based model explainability for every risk score
- Generates risk scores from 0-100 with severity classifications
- Detects honeypots, hidden owners, unlimited minting, selfdestruct, blacklist mechanisms, and high sell taxes

## API

- Production API: https://api.sentinelx.site
- POST /analyze — Analyze a contract address or Solidity source code
- GET /health — Check API status and model loading state
- GET /metrics — Retrieve model evaluation metrics

## Disclaimer

SentinelX provides automated security analysis for informational purposes only. It does not guarantee detection of all scams or the safety of any token. Analysis results are not financial advice.
